cards.example_en: The author signed my book at the school fair.
cards.example_zh: 作者在学校义卖会上给我的书签了名。

cards.example_en: The local authority closed the road.
cards.example_zh: 当地政府封锁了道路。

cards.example_en: The automatic doors opened as we entered the supermarket.
cards.example_zh: 我们走进超市时，自动门打开了。

cards.example_en: The region is an autonomous area.
cards.example_zh: 这个地区是自治区。

cards.example_en: Seats are still available for the concert in the school hall.
cards.example_zh: 学校礼堂的音乐会还有空位。

cards.example_en: The view from the cable car was awesome in clear weather.
cards.example_zh: 天气晴朗时，从缆车看出去的景色棒极了。

cards.example_en: His awkward hands dropped the cups while he washed up.
cards.example_zh: 他笨拙的双手在洗碗时把杯子掉了。

cards.example_en: He stepped backward to avoid the bike.
cards.example_zh: 他向后退了一步躲开自行车。

cards.example_en: The smell of bacon woke everyone on Saturday morning.
cards.example_zh: 星期六早上，熏猪肉的香味把大家都叫醒了。

cards.example_en: I buy fresh bread from the bakery every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我每天早上从面包店买新鲜面包。

cards.example_en: She has a ballet class on Saturday.
cards.example_zh: 她周六有芭蕾课。

cards.example_en: The school will ban phones in class.
cards.example_zh: 学校将禁止上课时使用手机。

cards.example_en: He broke a bar of chocolate and shared it at lunch.
cards.example_zh: 他掰开一条巧克力，午饭时分给大家吃。

cards.example_en: We ate barbecue in the garden on Saturday evening.
cards.example_zh: 星期六晚上，我们在花园里吃了烧烤。

cards.example_en: I barely caught the bus.
cards.example_zh: 我差点没赶上公交车。

cards.example_en: The dog's bark woke the baby at midnight.
cards.example_zh: 半夜，一阵狗吠把宝宝吵醒了。

cards.example_en: Language was a barrier at first.
cards.example_zh: 起初语言是个障碍。

cards.example_en: The coach will base the lineup on yesterday's practice.
cards.example_zh: 教练会基于昨天的训练来安排首发名单。

cards.example_en: Mum washed the rice in a large basin.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈在大盆里把米洗干净了。

cards.example_en: Honesty is the basis of a strong friendship.
cards.example_zh: 诚实是一份牢固友谊的基础。

cards.example_en: My phone battery died during the bus ride home.
cards.example_zh: 坐公交车回家时，我的手机电池没电了。

cards.example_en: Soldiers from two villages fought a long battle beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 两个村子的士兵在河边打了一场很长的会战。

cards.example_en: Our family rented a boat on the quiet bay.
cards.example_zh: 我们一家人在平静的海湾租了一条船。

cards.example_en: The tomb dates from 200 BC.
cards.example_zh: 这座墓可追溯到公元前200年。

cards.example_en: We cooked bean curd with green vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 我们用豆腐炒了青菜。

cards.example_en: Grandpa's beard turned white after many years.
cards.example_zh: 许多年过去后，爷爷的胡子变白了。

cards.example_en: Her beauty drew smiles from everyone at the party.
cards.example_zh: 她的美貌让聚会上的每个人都露出了笑容。

cards.example_en: He does not drink beer.
cards.example_zh: 他不喝啤酒。

cards.example_en: I spoke on behalf of the class at the meeting.
cards.example_zh: 我在会上代表全班发了言。

cards.example_en: Good behaviour on the bus keeps everyone safe.
cards.example_zh: 公交车上的良好行为能保障每个人的安全。

cards.example_en: A human being needs water every day.
cards.example_zh: 人这种生物每天都需要水。

cards.example_en: He has a strong belief in himself.
cards.example_zh: 他对自己有很强的信心。

cards.example_en: You can bend the wire into a hook for the picture.
cards.example_zh: 你可以把这根铁丝弯曲成挂钩，用来挂画。

cards.example_en: The cat slept beneath the warm blanket on the sofa.
cards.example_zh: 猫睡在沙发上那条暖和毯子的下面。

cards.example_en: I would bet my snack that our class wins today.
cards.example_zh: 我愿意拿我的零食打赌，我们班今天会赢。

cards.example_en: The farm lies beyond the river, past the old bridge.
cards.example_zh: 农场在河的那一边，过了那座旧桥就到。

cards.example_en: More than one billion people watched the final online.
cards.example_zh: 超过十亿人在网上观看了那场决赛。

cards.example_en: He took a big bite of the apple.
cards.example_zh: 他咬了一大口苹果。

cards.example_en: The bitter medicine worked, though he hated the taste.
cards.example_zh: 这种苦药起了作用，尽管他讨厌那个味道。

cards.example_en: Don't blame the goalkeeper for one unlucky mistake.
cards.example_zh: 别因为一次倒霉的失误就责备守门员。

cards.example_en: Write your name on the blank line at the top of the page.
cards.example_zh: 把你的名字写在页面上方的空白线上。

cards.example_en: It's cold, so take an extra blanket.
cards.example_zh: 天气很冷，所以多拿一条毯子。

cards.example_en: Grandma will bless the family meal before anyone eats.
cards.example_zh: 大家吃饭前，奶奶会为这顿饭祝福。

cards.example_en: She writes a travel blog about weekend trips.
cards.example_zh: 她写一个旅行博客，记录周末的出行。

cards.example_en: The museum displayed an old bomb from the war.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆展出了一枚战争时期的旧炸弹。

cards.example_en: A strong bond grew between the two brothers.
cards.example_zh: 兄弟俩之间建立起牢固的纽带。

cards.example_en: The dog buried a bone under the garden tree.
cards.example_zh: 那只狗把一根骨头埋在花园的树下。

cards.example_en: Workers received a bonus after a busy month.
cards.example_zh: 忙碌了一个月之后，工人们领到了红利。

cards.example_en: A short walk can boost your energy.
cards.example_zh: 走一小段路能提神。

cards.example_en: Mud covered his left boot after the rainy hike.
cards.example_zh: 雨中徒步之后，泥巴糊满了他的左脚长靴。

word.example_en: They base the play on a school diary.
word.example_zh: 他们以一本校园日记为底本编这部剧。

word.example_en: We decide on the basis of the evidence.
I speak on behalf of the whole class.
New clubs come into being each autumn.
word.example_zh: 新社团每年秋天形成出现。

word.example_en: Belief in effort keeps the team going.
word.example_zh: 对努力的信念让队伍继续前进。

word.example_en: The crowd noise was beyond control.
Do not blame her for the rain delay.
word.example_zh: 不要因为下雨耽误而责备她。
